question: Do you offer a single-tenant or customer-dedicated deployment option?

draft.answer: No. Meridian is a multi-tenant software-as-a-service platform only. All customers are served from shared infrastructure, and Meridian does not operate single-tenant or customer-dedicated deployments (nor any on-premises or private-cloud distribution of the product).
